decision.explanation: The original sources present two distinct contexts involving Alfred Cannan. Document d1 describes him as a current Member of the Grand National Assembly of Turkey and as the representative of Istanbul's Beyoğlu district. These are supported by direct descriptions of his political role and responsibilities. Document d2 introduces another context where Alfred Cannan holds the position of Minister for the Treasury of the Isle of Man. This is explicitly stated and described in detail. Since these are separate geopolitical contexts (Turkey vs. Isle of Man), they refer to distinct roles held by the same individual in different jurisdictions. 'Minister for the Treasury' alone is incomplete without the jurisdiction, so the full title is retained.
